parser_at_build_commit.selection_rule: template source contains all of: 'Tool usage guidelines:', '<function name="', '<param name="'
parser_at_build_commit.bundled_template: models/templates/openbmb-MiniCPM5-1B.jinja (9062 bytes, byte-identical to the ModelScope MiniCPM5-1B chat_template.jinja)
parser_properties: PEG parser generated at request time from the declared tool schemas
only declared tool names and declared parameter names can match
string parameters accept plain or CDATA-wrapped values; other types are parsed by their JSON schema
lazy grammar constrains generation once '<function' is emitted
message shape: optional <think> block, optional content, then tool calls until end of output
multiple calls in one message require parallel_tool_calls

chat_templates.differences: The GGUF-embedded template and the 1B template split assistant content on <tool_sep> so content and tool-call XML are replayed in order; the BF16 repository chat_template.jinja appends all tool calls after the content. All three satisfy the llama.cpp selection rule.
